sources.title: GitHub - maskjp/lerobot_policy_mtdit_spatial
sources.snippet: Why this exists Stock multi_task_dit pools each camera to a single CLIP CLS token (get_output_shape () -> (768, 1, 1)), discarding all 196 patch tokens. That was a deliberate compactness tradeoff by the original author, who also lists "spatial grounding: insufficient visual localization" as the architecture's first known weakness.
